summary.text: Meg Weinberger is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 94, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Weinberger lives in Palm Beach Gardens, works as a development director, and sits on the boards of several organizations, including HCA Florida Palms West Hospital and Stetson University.
Weinberger was born in Detroit, Michigan, and moved to Florida in 1979.
